mainEntity.name: What is the construction process for building a guest suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: The project begins with an on-site consultation to discuss your budget, layout ideas, and household needs, followed by a detailed estimate. Once plans are approved, the team coordinates the necessary building permits. Construction starts with demolition or site excavation, followed by foundation and framing work. Trades then install rough plumbing, electrical wiring, and HVAC ducts before drywall installation, taping, and texturing. Finally, our craftspeople install bathroom tile, cabinetry, trim, and fixtures. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms coordinates every trade from start to final walk-through.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an initial site consultation, design planning, permitting, framing and utility rough-ins, drywall, tile and fixture installation, and a final inspection.
